description: The range scaling newly propagates GatedMLP's inherited width metadata mismatch into the compiled plan.
trigger: Compile an allocation for a GatedMLP already split into two slices, giving each device one slice; the constructor can create slices when the intermediate size exceeds its split threshold.
expected_behavior: Represent the two slice indices or translate them into channel boundaries using the actual slice widths.
actual_behavior: The record counts slices but multiplies offsets by 128, emitting [0,128) and [128,256) irrespective of those widths.

verification.description: Scaled the cumulative offsets for two one-slice assignments.
verification.limits: No in-tree consumer of compile_tp_plan was found, so no resulting tensor mis-slice was observed.

introductions.rationale: The task multiplies compiled plan offsets by channel_width, applying 128 to the inherited count in slices.
